invariants.rationale: The method uses intervals.length, so intervals must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The method expects the intervals array to be the same length as animationIntervals, otherwise it throws an exception.
A non-empty intervals array is implied by the operation of summing elements in a loop over the array.
animationIntervals.length is accessed, so animationIntervals must not be null.
If intervals and animationIntervals reference the same array, the logic could be unnecessary or may be an error.
